name: Reinet Investments S.C.A.
source: Reinet Investments S.C.A. audited consolidated cash flow statement for the year ended 31 March 2025, euros millions scaled to absolute euros
periods_note: Reinet is an investment entity: its consolidated statement presents only an operating section (the dividend received from Reinet Fund less operating expenses) and a financing section (the dividend paid), so there is no investing line and no capital expenditure to report. The statement itself shows cash and cash equivalents of nil at both year ends, and the net movement is nil in both years.
